_comment: VECTOR's eyes (holo/vector/eyes.py): the package's defaults. Yours goes in ~/.config/bromigos/vector/eyes.json. model: a multimodal model on your endpoint (empty: llm.py's vision default). Captures stay in memory. block adds to the built-in blocklist (password managers; banking, trading and wallet sites; Vault; private browsing): any visible window whose app class or title matches means no capture at all.
